drift_resolved.description: Spec requires `SqliteSpaceItemsRepository.updateItem()` method to be complete, but the actual implementation is truncated and incomplete - it ends abruptly with just the SQL preparation without the `.run()` call or error handling
Spec requires `SqliteSpacesRepository.mapRowToEntity()` to be a complete private method, but the actual implementation is truncated - the method signature exists but the implementation is cut off

Spec requires comprehensive infrastructure package structure including DatabaseInitializer, SchemaValidator, IntegrityChecker, ServiceRegistry, ServiceBootstrap, InMemoryEventBus, and ConsoleLogger classes, but only the repository implementations are present in the actual code
Spec specifies storing dates as ISO strings (`new Date().toISOString()`) but actual implementation stores dates as timestamps (`new Date().getTime()`)

Spec requires all remaining methods in `SqliteSpaceItemsRepository` (deleteItem, moveItem, reorderItems, pinItem, unpinItem, reorderPins, incrementVisitCount) but these are missing from the actual implementation
